2.0.13: Fixed a bug where manually queued tracks were excluded from the total song count when Full Playlist Estimation was active.
2.0.12: Fixed overlapping text in 'In-Queue Text' layout by switching to true inline injection.
2.0.11: Fixed an edge case where Spotify reports the current track index in a non-standard way, breaking playlist estimation.
2.0.10: Added aggressive diagnostic logging to debug playlist estimation.
2.0.9: Added Hot Reloading for Seamless Updates! Queue Time will now update itself perfectly without needing a Spotify restart!
2.0.8: Made Full Playlist Estimation completely bulletproof by using three different internal APIs to fetch playlist lengths.
2.0.7: Fixed Queue Time displaying incorrectly in the Queue page layout due to Spotify UI updates.
Re-implemented the classic non-destructive layout injection.
2.0.6: Fixed Full Playlist Estimation crashing due to Spotify API 429 rate limits.
Added zero-latency local Cosmos API fallback for instant estimation.
2.0.5: Added Full Playlist Time Estimation (bypasses 80 song limit)!
Updated settings UI text to be more accurate (showing seconds).
2.0.4: Added a sleek, native-feeling premium settings menu with rounded edges and micro-animations.
Added this beautiful startup changelog popup (brought over from Beautiful Release Date) so you always know what's new.
2.0.3: Added save queue to playlist button
